description.narrative: Mining Industry Tripartite Council (MITC) of Camarines Norte in Philippines restructured and enlarged its membership to include also small scale mining (SSM) workers’ associations. This improved its capacity to understand and initiate policy reforms to improve conditions in small scale mining (formal and informal), which accounts for the majority of the employment in the mining sector. Improved representation on MITC has also led to livelihood assistance support for miners in small scale mining during the pandemic years 2021-22. MITC has also set up a tripartite working group to develop industry standards for the SSM industry, and initiating skills recognition and certification for small scale miners. With the support of the US DOL, the ILO supported the SSMs in the Baseline and Sectoral Assessment data gathering, validation and planning activities aimed at surfacing decent work deficits as well as drivers of compliance and non-compliance. The ILO also facilitated the involvement of SSMs in the development of ITC Sectoral Plans to address priority issues and supported the capacity building of the SSMs to engage with other formal sector stakeholders.
